effect.title: Effect
effect.tooltip: The individual Effect section that can be modified by other nodes regardless of order.

animation.title: Animation
animation.tooltip: The individual Animation section that can be modified by other nodes regardless of order.

crosshair.title: Crosshair
crosshair.tooltip: The individual Crosshair section that can be modified by other nodes regardless of order.

ease.title: Ease
ease.tooltip: The easing function used for the animation.

delay.title: Delay
delay.tooltip: Delay in milliseconds before this part of the animation starts.

duration.title: Duration
duration.tooltip: Duration in milliseconds. Leave at 0 to skip.

gridUnits.title: Grid Units
gridUnits.tooltip: Treat the values as grid units instead of pixels.

local.title: Local
local.tooltip: Apply the offset in the effect's local (pre-rotation) space.

offset.title: Offset
offset.tooltip: Offset from the position, as an x/y vector. Leave at 0,0 to skip.

randomOffset.title: Random Offset
randomOffset.tooltip: Random offset multiplier within the target's bounds. Leave at 0 to skip.

cacheLocation.title: Cache Location
cacheLocation.tooltip: Capture the target's position immediately instead of when the effect plays.

attachTo.title: Attach To
attachTo.tooltip: Attach to the target so the effect follows it as it moves.

crosshair-pick.title: Pick Location
crosshair-pick.subtitle: Shows a crosshair and waits for placement

type.title: Type
type.tooltip: The template shape of the crosshair (circle, cone, rect, ray).

distance.title: Distance
distance.tooltip: Radius/length in grid units. Leave at 0 for the Sequencer default.

angle.title: Angle
angle.tooltip: Cone angle in degrees. Leave at 0 for the default.

direction.title: Direction
direction.tooltip: Starting direction in degrees (cone/ray). Leave at 0 to skip.

width.title: Width
width.tooltip: Ray width in grid units. Leave at 0 for the default.

label.title: Label
label.tooltip: Text shown on the crosshair. Leave empty to skip.

borderColor.title: Border Color
borderColor.tooltip: Hex color for the crosshair border (e.g. #000000). Leave empty for the default.

fillColor.title: Fill Color
fillColor.tooltip: Hex color for the crosshair fill. Leave empty for your user color.

gridHighlight.title: Grid Highlight
gridHighlight.tooltip: Highlights the affected grid squares. On by default.

lockDrag.title: Lock Drag
lockDrag.tooltip: Prevents dragging the end position. On by default.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.tooltip: Seconds to wait for a placement before cancelling. Leave at 0 for no timeout.

config.title: Config
config.tooltip: A JSON object deep-merged over the inputs for rare nested options (icon, location range limits, range polygon colors).

location.title: Location
location.tooltip: The chosen placement point, for use by Location nodes.

distanceOut.title: Distance
distanceOut.tooltip: The chosen distance in grid units.

outAfter.title: Out After
outAfter.tooltip: Executes after the loop is finished.

isFinal.title: Is Final
isFinal.tooltip: Whether this is the last iteration of the loop.

index.title: Index
index.tooltip: The current index of the loop (starting from 0).

name.title: Name
name.tooltip: Causes the effect’s position to be stored and can then be used with other nodes to refer to previous effects’ locations.

origin.title: Origin
origin.tooltip: Used for adding extra information to an effect, like the origin of the effect in the form of the item’s UUID to then be retrieved or ended.

effect.title: Effect
effect.tooltip: The individual Effect section that can be modified by other nodes regardless of order.

target.title: Target
target.tooltip: The token to animate. Movement, rotation, fading and visibility act on this object.

animation.title: Animation
animation.tooltip: The individual Animation section that can be modified by other nodes regardless of order.

name.title: Name
name.tooltip: Stores the crosshair's placement so later sections can reference it by name.

crosshair.title: Crosshair
crosshair.tooltip: The individual Crosshair section that can be modified by other nodes regardless of order.

remote.title: Remote
remote.tooltip: Causes the sequence to be executed on each users’ machine independently. This does not support .animation() sections when set to true.

preload.title: Preload
preload.tooltip: Causes any section with .file() entries to preload all files that would be played.

local.title: Local
local.tooltip: Causes sections to be played only locally to the user executing the sequence.

file.title: File
file.tooltip: Sequencer compatible file path (either a raw path or a Sequencer database path).

baseFolder.title: Base Folder
baseFolder.tooltip: A folder path prepended to relative file paths. Leave empty to skip.

mustache.title: Mustache
mustache.tooltip: A JSON object of values substituted into the file path using Handlebars/mustache syntax. Leave empty to skip.

location.title: Location
location.tooltip: Where the effect will be played.

snapToGrid.title: Snap To Grid
snapToGrid.tooltip: Snaps the effect's final location to the scene grid.

aboveUI.title: Above UI
aboveUI.tooltip: Renders the screen-space effect above all Foundry interface elements.

position.title: Position
position.tooltip: Screen-space position offset from the anchor. Leave at 0,0 to skip.

anchorX.title: Anchor X
anchorX.tooltip: Horizontal screen anchor (0 = left, 1 = right). Leave at -1 to use the default of 0.5.

anchorY.title: Anchor Y
anchorY.tooltip: Vertical screen anchor (0 = top, 1 = bottom). Leave at -1 to use the default of 0.5.

scale.title: Screen Scale
scale.tooltip: A JSON object with x, y, fitX, fitY, ratioX, ratioY controlling screen-space scaling. Leave empty to skip.

playIf.title: Play If
playIf.tooltip: The effect only plays when this is true. Defaults to true.

async.title: Async
async.tooltip: Waits for each repetition to finish before the next one starts.

waitUntilFinished.title: Wait Until Finished
waitUntilFinished.tooltip: Pauses the whole sequence until this effect finishes before continuing.

waitDelayMin.title: Min Wait
waitDelayMin.tooltip: Extra delay (ms) after finishing before continuing. With a max set, a random value between the two is used. May be negative to start next effect early.

waitDelayMax.title: Max Wait
waitDelayMax.tooltip: Upper bound (ms) for a random wait delay. Leave at 0 for a fixed delay.

delayMin.title: Min Delay
delayMin.tooltip: Delay (ms) before the effect plays. With a max set, a random value between the two is used. Leave at 0 to skip.

delayMax.title: Max Delay
delayMax.tooltip: Upper bound (ms) for a random play delay. Leave at 0 for a fixed delay.

repeats.title: Repeats
repeats.tooltip: How many times to repeat the effect. Leave at 0 to skip.

repeatDelayMin.title: Min Repeat Delay
repeatDelayMin.tooltip: Delay (ms) between repetitions. With a max set, a random value between the two is used.

repeatDelayMax.title: Max Repeat Delay
repeatDelayMax.tooltip: Upper bound (ms) for a random delay between repetitions. Leave at 0 for a fixed delay.

playbackRate.title: Playback Rate
playbackRate.tooltip: Multiplies playback speed (2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half). Leave at 1 to skip.

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.tooltip: Skips to this millisecond position within the effect. Leave at 0 to skip.

endTime.title: End Time
endTime.tooltip: Stops the effect at this millisecond position. Leave at 0 to skip.

startPerc.title: Start %
startPerc.tooltip: Skips to this fraction (0-1) of the effect's duration. Leave at 0 to skip.

endPerc.title: End %
endPerc.tooltip: Stops the effect at this fraction (0-1) of its duration. Leave at 0 to skip.

volume.title: Volume
volume.tooltip: Audio volume from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 to skip.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.tooltip: Rotates the effect's container by this many degrees. Leave at 0 to skip.

randomRotation.title: Random Rotation
randomRotation.tooltip: Applies a random rotation to the effect.

spriteRotation.title: Sprite Rotation
spriteRotation.tooltip: Rotates the sprite by this many degrees without rotating its container. Leave at 0 to skip.

randomSpriteRotation.title: Random Sprite Rotation
randomSpriteRotation.tooltip: Applies a random rotation to the sprite only.

zeroSpriteRotation.title: Zero Sprite Rotation
zeroSpriteRotation.tooltip: Keeps the sprite from rotating when its container rotates.

degrees.title: Degrees
degrees.tooltip: How many degrees to rotate over the animation.

scale.title: Scale
scale.tooltip: Overall size multiplier. Leave at 0 to skip.

scaleMax.title: Scale Max
scaleMax.tooltip: When above 0, a random uniform scale between Scale and this value is picked.

objectScale.title: Object Scale
objectScale.tooltip: Scales the effect relative to the target object's size (1 = match).

uniform.title: Uniform
uniform.tooltip: Scale both axes equally based on the object.

considerTokenScale.title: Consider Token Scale
considerTokenScale.tooltip: Factor the token's own scale into the calculation.

width.title: Width
width.tooltip: Effect width in pixels (or grid units). Leave at 0 to skip.

height.title: Height
height.tooltip: Effect height in pixels (or grid units). Leave at 0 to skip.

spriteScale.title: Sprite Scale
spriteScale.tooltip: Scales the sprite independently of the container. Leave at 0 to skip.

spriteScaleMax.title: Sprite Scale Max
spriteScaleMax.tooltip: When above 0, a random uniform sprite scale between Sprite Scale and this value is picked.

fadeScale.title: Scale
fadeScale.tooltip: The scale to animate from (in) or to (out).

anchorX.title: Anchor X
anchorX.tooltip: Horizontal pivot (0 = left, 1 = right). Leave at -1 to use the default of 0.5.

anchorY.title: Anchor Y
anchorY.tooltip: Vertical pivot (0 = top, 1 = bottom). Leave at -1 to use the default of 0.5.

center.title: Center
center.tooltip: Centers the sprite at the effect location (anchor 0.5, 0.5).

aim.title: Aim
aim.subtitle: Point, stretch or move towards a target

towards.title: Towards
towards.tooltip: The target to aim at: a point, a token/target, or a named effect. Required.

missed.title: Missed
missed.tooltip: Offsets the effect to simulate a missed attack.

rotationOffset.title: Rotation Offset
rotationOffset.tooltip: Extra rotation (degrees) applied after aiming. Leave at 0 to skip.

onlyX.title: Only X
onlyX.tooltip: Only stretches along the X axis to reach the target.

tiling.title: Tiling
tiling.tooltip: Tiles the texture along the stretched length instead of scaling it.

requiresLineOfSight.title: Requires Line Of Sight
requiresLineOfSight.tooltip: Skips the effect if walls block the line to the target.

hideLineOfSight.title: Hide Behind Walls
hideLineOfSight.tooltip: Hides the portion of the effect blocked by walls.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.tooltip: Rotates the effect to face the direction of movement. Defaults to true.

moveSpeed.title: Move Speed
moveSpeed.tooltip: Movement speed in pixels per frame. Leave at 0 to use the duration instead.

aboveLighting.title: Above Lighting
aboveLighting.tooltip: Renders the effect above darkness and fog-of-war.

aboveInterface.title: Above Interface
aboveInterface.tooltip: Renders the effect above all Foundry UI elements.

zIndex.title: Z-Index
zIndex.tooltip: Drawing order for effects at the same elevation. Leave at 0 to skip.

sortLayer.title: Sort Layer
sortLayer.tooltip: Canvas sort layer, placing the effect among tokens, tiles or weather. Leave at 0 to skip.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.tooltip: Vertical elevation of the effect. Leave at 0 (with Top at 0 and Absolute off) to skip.

elevationTop.title: Elevation Top
elevationTop.tooltip: When above 0, the effect spans an elevation range from Elevation to this value.

absolute.title: Absolute
absolute.tooltip: Treat the elevation as an absolute value rather than relative to the source.

topInclusive.title: Top Inclusive
topInclusive.tooltip: Range form only: include the top value in the range.

levels.title: Levels
levels.tooltip: Comma-separated level ids or names to restrict the effect to (Levels module). Leave empty to skip.

persist.title: Persist
persist.tooltip: Keeps the effect on the canvas indefinitely until ended through the Effect Manager.

persistTokenPrototype.title: Persist Token Prototype
persistTokenPrototype.tooltip: Stores the persisted effect on the token's prototype so copies inherit it.

temporary.title: Temporary
temporary.tooltip: Prevents a persisted effect's flags from being saved to the document.

extraEndDuration.title: Extra End Duration
extraEndDuration.tooltip: Keeps a persisted effect around for this many ms before removal. Leave at 0 to skip.

loops.title: Loops
loops.tooltip: How many times the effect loops. Leave at 0 for the default (infinite for persisted effects).

endOnLastLoop.title: End On Last Loop
endOnLastLoop.tooltip: Ends the effect when the final loop completes instead of holding the last frame.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.subtitle: Who sees the effect and how visible it is

locally.title: Locally
locally.tooltip: Plays the effect only on the current client.

private.title: Private
private.tooltip: Hides the effect from the Effect Manager UI.

xray.title: X-Ray
xray.tooltip: Makes the effect visible through walls and vision masking.

constrainedByWalls.title: Constrained By Walls
constrainedByWalls.tooltip: Clips the effect to the walls around its source.

users.title: Users
users.tooltip: Restricts the effect's visibility to these users. Leave unconnected to show to everyone.

masks.title: Masks
masks.tooltip: Tokens, tiles or regions the effect is masked to. Each entry adds a mask.

maskToSource.title: Mask To Source
maskToSource.tooltip: Masks the effect to its own source object.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.tooltip: Effect opacity from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 to skip.

tint.title: Tint
tint.tooltip: A hex color (e.g. #ff0000) overlaid on the effect. Leave empty to skip.

blendMode.title: Blend Mode
blendMode.tooltip: Compositing blend mode. Leave at normal to skip.

filterType.title: Filter
filterType.tooltip: The visual filter to apply. Leave at None to skip.

filterData.title: Filter Data
filterData.tooltip: A JSON object of options for the chosen filter.

filterName.title: Filter Name
filterName.tooltip: An optional name to reference this filter later.

text.title: Text
text.tooltip: The text to render as part of the effect. Required for this mode.

textStyle.title: Text Style
textStyle.tooltip: A JSON PIXI.TextStyle object controlling the text appearance.

shapeType.title: Shape
shapeType.tooltip: The kind of geometric shape to draw.

shapeOptions.title: Shape Options
shapeOptions.tooltip: A JSON object with radius, width, height, points, fillColor, etc. Required for this mode.

from.title: From
from.tooltip: The token or tile to copy as an effect. Required for this mode.

tilingScale.title: Tiling Scale
tilingScale.tooltip: Scale of the tiled texture as an x/y vector. Defaults to 1,1.

tilingPosition.title: Tiling Position
tilingPosition.tooltip: Position offset of the tiled texture as an x/y vector.

templateGridSize.title: Grid Size
templateGridSize.tooltip: The effect's internal grid size relative to the scene grid. Required for this mode.

templateStartPoint.title: Start Point
templateStartPoint.tooltip: Padding at the left edge of the templated effect.

templateEndPoint.title: End Point
templateEndPoint.tooltip: Padding at the right edge of the templated effect.

animate.title: Animate Property
animate.subtitle: Animates a raw property over time

target.title: Target
target.tooltip: Which part to animate, e.g. sprite, spriteContainer, alphaFilter. Defaults to sprite.

property.title: Property
property.tooltip: The property path to animate, e.g. position.x, rotation, alpha. Required.

fromEnd.title: From End
fromEnd.tooltip: Plays the animation from the end of the effect, like a fade out.

screenSpace.title: Screen Space
screenSpace.tooltip: Interprets position/size values in screen dimensions.

absolute.title: Absolute
absolute.tooltip: Overrides the current value rather than adding to it.

values.title: Values
values.tooltip: A JSON array of numbers to loop between. When set, overrides From/To.

loops.title: Loops
loops.tooltip: How many times to loop. Leave at 0 for infinite.

pingPong.title: Ping Pong
pingPong.tooltip: Reverses direction each loop instead of snapping back to the first value.

override.title: Override
override.tooltip: JavaScript run before the effect plays. Receives (effect, data) and must return data. Leave empty to skip.

tieTo.title: Tie To UUIDs
tieTo.tooltip: Comma-separated document UUIDs; the effect ends if any are deleted. Leave empty to skip.

tieToDocs.title: Tie To Documents
tieToDocs.tooltip: Documents the effect is tied to; the effect ends if any are deleted.

syncGroup.title: Sync Group
syncGroup.tooltip: Effects sharing this group name start at the same time. Leave empty to skip.

preset.title: Preset
preset.tooltip: Applies a registered preset by name. Leave empty to skip.

presetArgs.title: Preset Args
presetArgs.tooltip: A JSON array of arguments passed to the preset.

isometric.title: Isometric
isometric.tooltip: Renders the effect on the isometric plane (Isometric module).

isometricOverlay.title: Isometric Overlay
isometricOverlay.tooltip: Draws the effect as an isometric overlay.

playIf.title: Play If
playIf.tooltip: The animation only plays when this is true. Defaults to true.

async.title: Async
async.tooltip: Waits for each repetition to finish before the next one starts.

waitUntilFinished.title: Wait Until Finished
waitUntilFinished.tooltip: Pauses the whole sequence until this animation finishes before continuing.

waitDelayMin.title: Min Wait
waitDelayMin.tooltip: Extra delay (ms) after finishing before continuing. With a max set, a random value between the two is used. May be negative to start the next section early.

waitDelayMax.title: Max Wait
waitDelayMax.tooltip: Upper bound (ms) for a random wait delay. Leave at 0 for a fixed delay.

delayMin.title: Min Delay
delayMin.tooltip: Delay (ms) before the animation plays. With a max set, a random value between the two is used. Leave at 0 to skip.

delayMax.title: Max Delay
delayMax.tooltip: Upper bound (ms) for a random play delay. Leave at 0 for a fixed delay.

repeats.title: Repeats
repeats.tooltip: How many times to repeat the animation. Leave at 0 to skip.

repeatDelayMin.title: Min Repeat Delay
repeatDelayMin.tooltip: Delay (ms) between repetitions. With a max set, a random value between the two is used.

repeatDelayMax.title: Max Repeat Delay
repeatDelayMax.tooltip: Upper bound (ms) for a random delay between repetitions. Leave at 0 for a fixed delay.

towards.title: Towards
towards.tooltip: The destination: a point, a token/target, or a named effect. Required.

closestSquare.title: Closest Square
closestSquare.tooltip: Picks the closest non-overlapping square to the target.

snapToGrid.title: Snap To Grid
snapToGrid.tooltip: Snaps the final position to the scene grid.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.tooltip: Rotates the target to face its direction of movement. Defaults to true.

moveSpeed.title: Move Speed
moveSpeed.tooltip: Movement speed in pixels per frame. Leave at 0 to use the duration instead.

relativeToCenter.title: Relative To Center
relativeToCenter.tooltip: Teleports relative to the target's center instead of its origin.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.tooltip: Adds this many degrees to the target's rotation. Leave at 0 to skip.

randomRotation.title: Random Rotation
randomRotation.tooltip: Applies a random rotation to the target.

towards.title: Towards
towards.tooltip: A point or object to rotate the target towards. Leave unconnected to skip.

towardsCenter.title: Towards Center
towardsCenter.tooltip: Rotates towards the center of the target rather than its edge. Defaults to true.

degrees.title: Degrees
degrees.tooltip: How many degrees to rotate over the animation.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.tooltip: Target opacity from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 to skip.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.tooltip: Hide or show the target as part of the animation.

volume.title: Volume
volume.tooltip: Audio volume from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 to skip.

tint.title: Tint
tint.tooltip: A hex color (e.g. #ff0000) applied to the target. Leave empty to skip.

preset.title: Preset
preset.tooltip: Applies a registered preset by name. Leave empty to skip.

type.title: Type
type.tooltip: The template shape (circle, cone, rect, ray).

distance.title: Distance
distance.tooltip: Radius/length in grid units. Leave at 0 to skip.

distanceMin.title: Min Distance
distanceMin.tooltip: Minimum draggable distance. Leave at 0 for the default.

distanceMax.title: Max Distance
distanceMax.tooltip: Maximum draggable distance. Leave at 0 for the default.

angle.title: Angle
angle.tooltip: Cone angle in degrees. Leave at 0 to skip.

direction.title: Direction
direction.tooltip: Starting direction in degrees (cone/ray). Leave at 0 to skip.

width.title: Width
width.tooltip: Ray width in grid units. Leave at 0 to skip.

snapPosition.title: Snap Position
snapPosition.tooltip: Grid snapping mode for the position (CONST.GRID_SNAPPING_MODES). Leave at -1 to skip.

snapDirection.title: Snap Direction
snapDirection.tooltip: Degrees the direction snaps along. Leave at 0 to skip.

label.title: Label
label.tooltip: Text shown on the crosshair. Leave empty to skip.

icon.title: Icon
icon.tooltip: Texture path for a custom icon. Leave empty to skip.

iconBorderVisible.title: Icon Border
iconBorderVisible.tooltip: Shows a border around the icon.

borderColor.title: Border Color
borderColor.tooltip: Hex color for the border (e.g. #000000). Leave empty to skip.

borderAlpha.title: Border Alpha
borderAlpha.tooltip: Border opacity from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 for the default.

fillColor.title: Fill Color
fillColor.tooltip: Hex color for the fill. Leave empty to skip.

fillAlpha.title: Fill Alpha
fillAlpha.tooltip: Fill opacity from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 for the default.

texture.title: Texture
texture.tooltip: Texture path for the crosshair. Leave empty to skip.

textureAlpha.title: Texture Alpha
textureAlpha.tooltip: Texture opacity from 0 to 1. Leave at -1 for the default.

textureScale.title: Texture Scale
textureScale.tooltip: Texture scale multiplier. Leave at 0 for the default.

gridHighlight.title: Grid Highlight
gridHighlight.tooltip: Highlights the affected grid squares. On by default.

location.title: Location
location.tooltip: Anchor the crosshair around this token and limit its range. Leave unconnected to skip.

limitMinRange.title: Min Range
limitMinRange.tooltip: Minimum range from the anchor in grid units. Leave at 0 to skip.

limitMaxRange.title: Max Range
limitMaxRange.tooltip: Maximum range from the anchor in grid units. Leave at 0 to skip.

lockToEdge.title: Lock To Edge
lockToEdge.tooltip: Locks the crosshair to the edge of the range.

lockToEdgeDirection.title: Lock Edge Direction
lockToEdgeDirection.tooltip: Locks the direction to point away from the anchor.

wallBehavior.title: Wall Behavior
wallBehavior.tooltip: How walls restrict placement (anywhere, line of sight, no collidables).

lockDrag.title: Lock Drag
lockDrag.tooltip: Prevents dragging the end position. On by default.

lockManualRotation.title: Lock Rotation
lockManualRotation.tooltip: Prevents manual rotation of the crosshair.

persist.title: Persist
persist.tooltip: Spawns a measured template matching the crosshair after placement.

name.title: Name
name.tooltip: Required name of the animation, filtering which animations are triggered. Comma separated for multiple animations.

actor.title: Actor
actor.tooltip: The origin actor of the animation.

options.title: Options
options.tooltip: A list of string options that can be used to modify the effect (e.g. pf2e roll options).

path.title: Path
path.tooltip: Extracts whatever data you want from a given path of the provided data (e.g. outcome).

softFail.title: Soft Fail
softFail.tooltip: Makes sequencer consider all failures to find files a non-issue and continue executing the sequence, rather than halt the execution.
